finding: Performance degrades as node count and traffic load increase
notes: Monotonic PDR decline with N confirmed in all 3 protocols in the rerun. Absolute PDR levels differ from the frozen pooled reference because the rerun uses only medium traffic + static mobility (a 3-seed subset of one condition), not the full pooled low/medium/high x static/low/medium average -- this is an expected, correctly-scoped difference, not a reproducibility failure (see reproducibility_comparison.csv for the exact same-condition row-level bit-identical match).

finding: V4 routing activation does not imply performance improvement
reference_evidence: Tier-1 Config 6: 11/11 seeds activated (100%), hop +27.9%, PDR change +3.5% (not significant, p=1.0)
notes: Per instructions, V4 was excluded from this validation matrix (no approved V4 configuration could be executed without risking a source/config change beyond what was explicitly authorized for this check). The frozen V4 finding is not challenged and is not re-verified by this validation round.

finding: Gateway/first-hop congestion is the dominant measurable bottleneck under near-saturated conditions
notes: 3-seed subset mean differs trivially from the 11-seed mean (expected sampling difference, not a reproducibility issue) -- per-seed row values are bit-identical to the frozen dataset (reproducibility_comparison.csv, 0 FAIL).

finding: Reducing offered rate improves OLSR PDR at N=75 and N=100
notes: Bit-identical to frozen reference (rounding-level difference only in the reported delta).

finding: Static/N=50 does not show the same improvement
